summary: A person moved a subscribed kind's cursor back, so the kind's chain hands its plugins again every line after the new cursor; every rewind is a line of its own.

key.description: The kind whose cursor moved back.

line.description: The last line the kind's chain had handled before the rewind; null when it had handled none.
The line the cursor now stands after, the next line handed being the first of the kind after it; null when the cursor stands at the journal's start.
